00049 static inline const String timeToTimecodeString (const double seconds)
00050 {
00051     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00052     const tchar* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? T("-") : T("");
00053     
00054     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00055     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00056     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00057     const int ms = roundDoubleToInt (absSecs * 1000) % 1000;
00058     
00059     if(hours == 0)
00060     {
00061         if(mins == 0)
00062         {
00063             return String::formatted (T("%s%01d.%03d"), sign, secs, ms);            
00064         }
00065         else
00066         {
00067             return String::formatted (T("%s%01d:%02d.%03d"), sign, mins, secs, ms);         
00068         }
00069     }
00070     else
00071     {
00072         return String::formatted (T("%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d"), sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00073     }
00074 }

00147 void ScopeComponent::paintBipolar(Graphics& g)
00148 {
00149     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00150     
00151     if(numChannels > 0)
00152     {
00153         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00154         
00155         const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00156         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00157         
00158         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00159             
00160         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00161         {
00162             const int top = channelHeight * channel;
00163             const int middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00164             const int bottom = top + channelHeight;
00165             
00166             if(channel > 0)
00167             {
00168                 g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00169                 g.drawHorizontalLine(top, 0, getWidth());
00170             }
00171             
00172             paintXScale(g, middle);
00173             paintYScale(g, middle, top);
00174             paintYScale(g, middle, bottom);
00175             
00176             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00177             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00178             
00179             g.setColour(Colour(colours[Trace].get32bitColour()));
00180             g.drawVerticalLine(0, middle - oldMaximum, middle - oldMinimum);
00181             
00182             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00183             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00184                                     
00185             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00186             {               
00187                 const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00188                 const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00189                 
00190                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00191                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00192                 
00193                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00194                 {
00195                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00196                     {
00197                         lineTop = 0.f;
00198                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00199                     }
00200                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00201                     {
00202                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00203                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00204                     }
00205                 }
00206                 
00207                 lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00208                 lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00209                                 
00210                 g.drawVerticalLine(i, lineTop, lineBottom);             
00211                 
00212                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00213                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00214             }
00215             
00216             paintChannelLabel(g, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00217         }       
00218     }
00219 }

00294 void ScopeComponent::paintXScale(Graphics& g, const int y)
00295 {
00296     g.setColour(Colour(colours[ZeroLine].get32bitColour()));
00297     g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, getWidth());
00298     
00299     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00300     {       
00301         const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00302         const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getDisplayBufferSize() / audioBufferSize;
00303         
00304         const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00305         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00306 
00307         unsigned int mark = 0;
00308         const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00309         const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00310         
00311         g.setFont(textSizeX);
00312         g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00313         
00314         for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00315         {           
00316             const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00317             
00318             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00319             {
00320                 g.drawVerticalLine(x, y - markXHeight * 1.5, y);
00321                 
00322                 
00323                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00324                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00325                 ) {
00326                     String label;
00327                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00328                     {
00329                         label = timeToTimecodeString((audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00330                     }
00331                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00332                     {
00333                         const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00334                         const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00335                         
00336                         if(binFreq >= 1000.0)
00337                             label = String(binFreq * 0.001, 2) + T("kHz");
00338                         else
00339                             label = String((int)(binFreq + 0.5)) + T("Hz");
00340                     }
00341                     else
00342                     {
00343                         label = String((int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00344                     }
00345                     
00346                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextX].get32bitColour()));
00347                     g.drawSingleLineText(label, x + labelOffsetX, y - labelOffsetY);
00348                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00349                 }
00350             }
00351             else
00352             {
00353                 g.drawVerticalLine(x, y-markXHeight, y);
00354             }
00355             
00356             mark++;
00357         }
00358         
00359     }
00360 }

00362 void ScopeComponent::paintYScale(Graphics& g, const int zero, const int maximum)
00363 {   
00364     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00365     {       
00366         const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00367         const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00368         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00369         
00370         unsigned int mark = 0;
00371         const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00372         const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00373         
00374         const int height = zero-maximum;
00375         const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00376         
00377         const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00378         
00379         g.setFont(textSizeY);
00380         g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00381         
00382         for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00383         {
00384             const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00385                         
00386             if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00387                (mark > 0) && 
00388                ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00389             ) {
00390                 g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth * 1.5);
00391                 if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00392                 {
00393                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextY].get32bitColour()));
00394                     g.drawSingleLineText(String(sign * level, decimalPlaces), labelOffsetX, y + labelOffsetY);
00395                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00396                 }
00397             }
00398             else
00399             {
00400                 g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth);
00401             }
00402             
00403             mark++;
00404         }
00405     }
00406 }

00408 void ScopeComponent::paintChannelLabel(Graphics& g, Text const& label, const int index, const int top)
00409 {
00410     if(labelChannels)
00411     {
00412         const int size = 256;

00414         
00415         if(label.length() == 0)
00416         {
00417             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, "Ch%d", index + channelLabelOffset);
00418         }
00419         else
00420         {
00421             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, (const char*)label, index + channelLabelOffset);
00422         }
00423         
00424         g.setFont(textSizeChannel);
00425         g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextChannel].get32bitColour()));
00426         
00427         const int left = scaleY == ScopeGUI::LabelYNone ? 3 : markYWidth * 1.5 + 3;
00428         
00429         g.drawText(labelToPaint, 
00430                    left, 
00431                    top + 3, 
00432                    getWidth() - left - 3, 
00433                    textSizeChannel, 
00434                    Justification::right, 
00435                    false);
00436     }

00465 void RadialScopeComponent::paintBipolar(Graphics& g)
00466 {
00467     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00468     
00469     if(numChannels > 0)
00470     {
00471         const int centreX = getCentreX();
00472         const int centreY = getCentreY();
00473         const float innerMargin = min(getLowerMargin(), (float)getRadius());
00474         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00475         const int channelHeight = (getRadius() - innerMargin) / numChannels;
00476         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00477         const int wrapOffset = bufferWrap * minDrawBuffer.size();
00478         
00479         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00480         
00481         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00482         {
00483             const int minRadius = channelHeight * channel + innerMargin;
00484             const int zeroRadius = minRadius + halfChannelHeight;
00485             const int maxRadius = minRadius + channelHeight;
00486             
00487             // outer
00488             g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00489             g.drawEllipse(getCentreX()-maxRadius, getCentreY()-maxRadius, maxRadius*2, maxRadius*2, 1);
00490             
00491             paintXScale(g, zeroRadius);
00492             paintYScale(g, zeroRadius, maxRadius);
00493             paintYScale(g, zeroRadius, minRadius);
00494             
00495 //          float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00496 //          float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00497             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00498             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00499             
00500             const double delta = getDelta() * sine.size();
00501             double position = delta;
00502             
00503             // first scope line
00504             g.setColour(Colour(colours[Trace].get32bitColour()));
00505             g.drawVerticalLine(centreX, 
00506                                centreY - zeroRadius - oldMaximum, 
00507                                centreY - zeroRadius - oldMinimum);
00508             
00509             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00510             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00511             
00512             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++, position += delta)
00513             {               
00514 //              const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00515 //              const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00516                 const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00517                 const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00518                 
00519                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00520                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00521                 
00522                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00523                 {
00524                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00525                     {
00526                         lineTop = 0.f;
00527                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00528                     }
00529                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00530                     {
00531                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00532                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00533                     }
00534                 }
00535                 
00536                 lineTop = zeroRadius - lineTop;
00537                 lineBottom = zeroRadius - lineBottom;
00538                                 
00539                 const float sinAngle = sine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00540                 const float cosAngle = cosine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00541                 
00542                 const float startX = sinAngle * lineBottom;
00543                 const float startY = cosAngle * lineBottom;
00544                 const float endX = sinAngle * lineTop;
00545                 const float endY = cosAngle * lineTop;
00546                 g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00547                            centreY - startY, 
00548                            centreX + endX, 
00549                            centreY - endY);
00550                 
00551                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00552                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00553             }
00554             
00555             //paintChannelLabel(g, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00556         }   
00557         
00558         
00559         if(innerMargin > 0)
00560         {           
00561             // inner
00562             g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00563             g.drawEllipse(getCentreX()-innerMargin, getCentreY()-innerMargin, innerMargin*2, innerMargin*2, 1);
00564         }
00565     }
00566

00569 void RadialScopeComponent::paintXScale(Graphics& g, const int radius)

00577     g.drawEllipse(centreX-radius, centreY-radius, diameter, diameter, 1);

00579     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00580     {       
00581 //      ugen_assert(bufferWrap == 0.0); // need to upate this function if the waveform is rotated...
00582

00584         const double radiansPerSample = twopi / audioBufferSize;

00602             const float startX = sinAngle * radius;
00603             const float startY = cosAngle * radius;
00604             
00605             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))

00608                 const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00609                 const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00610                 g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00611                            centreY - startY,

00613                            centreY - endY);
00614                 
00615                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00616                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)

00618                     String label;
00619                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00620                     {
00621                         label = timeToTimecodeString((audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00622                     }
00623                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00624                     {
00625                         const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00626                         const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00627                         
00628                         if(binFreq >= 1000.0)
00629                             label = String(binFreq * 0.001, 2) + T("kHz");
00630                         else

00632                     }

00636                     }
00637                     
00638                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextX].get32bitColour()));               
00639                     const double rotation = -pi2+angle;
00640                     //if(angle > pi) rotation += pi;
00641                     AffineTransform transform = AffineTransform::identity.rotated(rotation).translated(centreX+endX*1.01, centreY-endY*1.01);
00642                     g.drawTextAsPath(label, transform);
00643                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00644                 }
00645             }
00646             else
00647             {               
00648                 const float end = radius + markXHeight;
00649                 const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00650                 const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00651                 g.drawLine(centreX + startX, 
00652                            centreY - startY, 
00653                            centreX + endX, 
00654                            centreY - endY);
00655             }
00656             
00657             mark++;
00658         }
00659         
00660     }
00661     
00662 }
